Setup commands for tp.example.test (Teleport 19.1.2), generated by the
tangra deployment wizard. Run them on the Teleport host once install.sh has
finished and https://tp.example.test/ answers.

1. Create the first administrator. Open the invite link tctl prints and set
   a password and second factor:

   sudo tctl users add admin --roles=editor,access,auditor --logins=root,ubuntu

2. Create the least-privilege role and the management identity tangra signs
   in with (tangra-manager-role.yaml was downloaded with this file):

   sudo tctl create -f tangra-manager-role.yaml
   sudo tctl users add tangra-mgmt --roles=tangra-manager
   sudo tctl auth sign --user=tangra-mgmt --format=file --ttl=720h --out=tangra-mgmt.identity

3. Register the cluster in tangra: choose "Register this cluster" in the
   wizard. The proxy address is tp.example.test:443; upload tangra-mgmt.identity
   as the credential, then delete the file from the host.
